categories.evidence: All player and complete corner views show a clear central transfer area, distinct medical workflow destinations and adequate visual separation between OCRU and recovery/supply furniture. Dark doorway header limits text legibility slightly; route remains clear.

Specific manufactured silhouettes, believable proportions, broad rose/navy/blue/rust color blocking and restrained localized detail match approved spawn principles. Angular OCRU, framed doors, authored trolley, inset cabinet and industrial console avoid generic primitive or uniform bevel construction.

OCRU canopy, elevated segmented transfer bed, rails, carriage, insert/release controls and suit coupling form a coherent specialized machine. Single red canopy practical establishes authority; restart/cartridges/decon are subordinate functional destinations.

Matte plaster/paint, cream cloth, dark upholstery/rubber, steel rail/guards, frosted cabinet glass, paper/cardboard and opaque bottles are differentiated. Deducted for comparatively smooth OCRU pad tops and strong fragmented grazing-angle floor highlights in rear cutaways.

Low-key ceiling/recesses, localized red OCRU practical, dim warm supply bench cone and restrained cool service-area fill create bleakness while paths and functional silhouettes remain legible. Hidden-bag inspection fill excluded. Door header is near the lower readability limit.

Denied-release shift log, Organic Continuity and productivity/return-to-work messaging, prepared gloves/instruments, open reserve-power door, empty cartridge slot, patched paint, dark floor stain and concealed closed bag imply care interrupted by institutional coercion. Human work is communicated through purposeful clusters and localized neglect.
